confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on several crowd-sourced and guide sources, but peso inflation moves prices quickly, so they may already be stale. Hotel anchors are low confidence because sources disagree widely (3-star averages ranged from about $118 to $229). Wine is derived from beer using a Feb 2025 Buenos Aires Herald ratio of wine to beer (about 1.4x), since no current wine price was found. The FX observation is from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page dated 2026-03-20, not the latest published rate, and the page was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors come from Buenos Aires-specific aggregated sources (Expatistan, Cheapflights, HotelsCombined, BudgetYourTrip, Hostelz, guide-style cost-of-living pages), with peso prices converted to USD at an implied rate of roughly 1,480 ARS per USD.
